0be805a6 (Notealot                    2021-12-03 14:49:16 +0800 505) func (engine *Engine) validateHeader(header string) (clientIP string, valid bool) {

0be805a6 (Notealot                    2021-12-03 14:49:16 +0800 516)

0be805a6 (Notealot                    2021-12-03 14:49:16 +0800 522) 	}
